rows.notes: The document is explicitly labelled a Review (Frontiers in Plant Science, 'TYPE Review'). Its only original content is a bibliometric keyword/author/country co-occurrence analysis of 13,738 WOS papers (Section 2) and an informal trial of GPT-4 on two apple-leaf images (Section 6.2, Figure 9); neither is a primary experiment on UAV-based remote sensing improving disease diagnostics, treatment strategies, or targeted agrochemical application. All reported accuracies (e.g., Calou et al. SVM 99.28%, Xiao et al. RF 94.0%, Marin et al. LMT 91.5%) are results cited from other studies. Q1 is therefore 'no' and Q2-Q9 follow as 'no'.

notes: Full text appears complete (abstract through references and abbreviations). The study is a narrative/bibliometric review, not a primary study; it cannot provide own evidence for any claim.
